# Scope the upstream options to this subdirectory. Only the explicit static
# target is linked by TemplateTool; exclude upstream install rules and targets.
set(CMAKE_POLICY_DEFAULT_CMP0077 NEW)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS ON)
set(BUILD_SHARED_DEPS_LIBS OFF)
set(NO_MEDIA ON)
set(NO_WEBSOCKET ON)
set(NO_EXAMPLES ON)
set(NO_TESTS ON)
set(NO_SERVER ON)
set(PREFER_SYSTEM_LIB OFF)
set(USE_GNUTLS OFF)
set(USE_MBEDTLS OFF)
set(USE_NICE OFF)
set(USE_SYSTEM_JUICE OFF)
set(USE_SYSTEM_PLOG OFF)
set(USE_SYSTEM_USRSCTP OFF)
set(PLOG_BUILD_SAMPLES OFF)
set(PLOG_BUILD_TESTS OFF)
set(PLOG_INSTALL OFF)
set(RTC_UPDATE_VERSION_HEADER OFF)
set(sctp_build_fuzzer OFF)
set(sctp_build_programs OFF)
set(sctp_build_shared_lib OFF)

if(NOT TARGET openssl)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "libdatachannel requires TemplateTool's openssl target")
endif()

add_subdirectory(libdatachannel-0.24.8 EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)

add_library(libdatachannel INTERFACE)
target_link_libraries(libdatachannel INTERFACE LibDataChannel::LibDataChannelStatic)
set_target_properties(libdatachannel PROPERTIES FOLDER framework/thirdparty/libdatachannel)

set(vendor_directory "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/libdatachannel-0.24.8")
set(license_directory share/licenses/libdatachannel)
install(FILES README.md "${vendor_directory}/LICENSE" DESTINATION "${license_directory}")
install(FILES "${vendor_directory}/deps/libjuice/LICENSE" DESTINATION "${license_directory}/libjuice")
install(FILES "${vendor_directory}/deps/plog/LICENSE" DESTINATION "${license_directory}/plog")
install(FILES "${vendor_directory}/deps/usrsctp/LICENSE.md" DESTINATION "${license_directory}/usrsctp")
